description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemption entity class, which maps to the 'hs_hr_emp_us_tax' database table. It models the tax exemption details for US employees within the OrangeHRM system, including federal and state tax statuses, exemptions, and related information. The class interacts with the Employee entity and provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemption
classes.description: Entity class representing US tax exemption details associated with an employee, using Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this tax exemption record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object associated with this tax exemption record.

methods.name: getFederalStatus
methods.description: Returns the federal tax status of the employee.

methods.name: setFederalStatus
methods.description: Sets the federal tax status of the employee.

methods.name: getFederalExemptions
methods.description: Returns the number of federal tax exemptions.

methods.name: setFederalExemptions
methods.description: Sets the number of federal tax exemptions.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state for tax purposes.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state for tax purposes.

methods.name: getStateExemptions
methods.description: Returns the number of state tax exemptions.

methods.name: setStateExemptions
methods.description: Sets the number of state tax exemptions.
